Customs

Kiểm tra quản trị

A formal review of compliance, control processes, and regulatory adherence for shipping, customs documentation, and trade operations, ensuring all transport documents and IDs meet authority requirements.

Quick answer: A formal review of compliance, control processes, and regulatory adherence for shipping, customs documentation, and trade operations, ensuring all transport documents and IDs meet authority requirements.

Quick answer

Why it matters

Kiểm tra quản trị matters because it supports clear communication in Customs contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Questions and answers

What is Kiểm tra quản trị?

In this glossary, Kiểm tra quản trị refers to: A formal review of compliance, control processes, and regulatory adherence for shipping, customs documentation, and trade operations, ensuring all transport documents and IDs meet authority requirements.

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Phải kiểm tra quản trị trước khi phát hành vận đơn để đảm bảo tuân thủ đầy đủ quy định."

Kiểm tra quản trị matters because it supports clear communication in Customs contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A formal review of compliance, control processes, and regulatory adherence for shipping, customs documentation, and trade operations, ensuring all transport documents and IDs meet authority requirements.

Operational example

A governance check is required before the Bill of Lading can be released to ensure full regulatory and compliance alignment.
